## Winning on million-row training tasks

**relflow beats both leading TabPFN-Rel variants on 6 of the 9 largest
training tasks**, including **all four Amazon tasks**. These tasks contain
**1.36 million to 5.49 million training examples each**. relflow takes
**5 first places** and finishes in the **top three on 8 of 9** among models.

::: {.benchmark-table .benchmark-scale}
| Task | Training anchors | Metric | relflow | TabPFN API | TabPFN Local |
| :--- | ---: | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Amazon item churn | 2,536,014 | ROC AUC ↑ | **0.83004** | 0.82865 | 0.82768 |
| Amazon item lifetime value | 2,707,679 | MAE ↓ | **39.85799** | 45.27051 | 45.34961 |
| Amazon user churn | 4,708,383 | ROC AUC ↑ | **0.71232** | 0.71170 | 0.70667 |
| Amazon user lifetime value | 4,708,383 | MAE ↓ | **13.87529** | 13.87712 | 13.88577 |
| H&M item sales | 5,488,184 | MAE ↓ | 0.04453 | **0.03648** | 0.03654 |
| H&M user churn | 3,832,692 | ROC AUC ↑ | **0.70851** | 0.70602 | 0.70542 |
| Stack Exchange post votes | 2,453,921 | MAE ↓ | 0.06362 | **0.06273** | 0.06284 |
| Stack Exchange user badge | 3,386,276 | ROC AUC ↑ | **0.89315** | 0.88344 | 0.88463 |
| Stack Exchange user engagement | 1,360,743 | ROC AUC ↑ | 0.90712 | 0.90766 | **0.90774** |
:::

::: {.benchmark-caption}
Bold marks the best of these three models, using unrounded scores. Both
TabPFN columns use the September 28 submissions. Higher ROC AUC and lower
mean absolute error (MAE) are better.
[Published scores and training counts](https://github.com/PriorLabs/relarena/blob/fa4f1468c02b7dafd0c7b107544a887b83ca04c1/baseline_results/results.csv).
:::

On Amazon item lifetime value, relflow cuts MAE by **12.0% against the
leading TabPFN-Rel API**. On the full LARGE group it also beats RelGT and
RelGNN-ES on **all 9 tasks**, and GraphSAGE on **8 of 9**.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Task sizes and training setup"}
This group is the adapter's predefined **LARGE tier**: at least 500,000
original inner training anchors. Every task in that tier exceeds one
million anchors in this snapshot. An anchor is one entity at one
prediction cutoff; the same entity can appear at multiple cutoffs. Counts
come from the published run configurations.

relflow learns from large datasets through batched training
and bounded nested histories. This submission uses eight pass-equivalents
and size-based resource limits, with training anchors streamed through
the data loader. LARGE runs use an RTX Pro 6000 and finish within the
benchmark's 24-hour ceiling. The
[published adapter](https://github.com/PriorLabs/relarena/blob/fa4f1468c02b7dafd0c7b107544a887b83ca04c1/docs/models/relflow.md)
records the history caps, batch sizes, workers, and preparation limits.
:::

## Two TabPFN variants, then relflow

The two higher-ranked models are **TabPFN-Rel API** and **TabPFN-Rel Local**:
two deployments of the same model family. Both combine
[TabPFN in-context learning with synthesized relational features](https://github.com/PriorLabs/relarena/blob/fa4f1468c02b7dafd0c7b107544a887b83ca04c1/README.md#how-it-works).
relflow learns from nested observations, using **one fixed configuration
per training-size tier**.

relflow ranks ahead of every reproduced GNN model, Nori-Rel, RDBLearn,
entity-only LightGBM, and the earlier TabPFN-Rel submissions in the complete
model board.

These are the published model-board point estimates. Elo is fitted across
all pairwise task comparisons, with the global constant predictor anchored
at 1000. The intervals come from resampling tasks; they overlap and do not
measure variation across training seeds. “Latest” TabPFN rows refer to the
September 28 submissions; “August” rows refer to August 15.
[Source and ranking protocol](https://github.com/PriorLabs/relarena/blob/fa4f1468c02b7dafd0c7b107544a887b83ca04c1/README.md#-leaderboards).
:::

## Wins against strong baselines

Across the same 21 held-out tasks, relflow beats the latest TabPFN-Rel API
on **11 tasks** head-to-head. Its aggregate Elo rank is third because the
leaderboard also accounts for comparisons against every other model.

::: {.benchmark-table}
| Opponent | Tasks won by relflow |
| :--- | ---: |
| TabPFN-Rel API (latest) | **11 / 21** |
| LightGBM (entity-only) | **20 / 21** |
| RelGT | **19 / 21** |
| GraphSAGE | **18 / 21** |
| RelGNN-ES | **18 / 21** |
| RDBLearn | **16 / 21** |
:::

relflow takes first place among models on Amazon item lifetime value,
user lifetime value and user churn; H&M user churn; Stack Exchange user
badge; and clinical-trial site success. **Three of those are outright wins
across all 17 models and systems**:

::: {.benchmark-table}
| Task | relflow | Best competing method | Result |
| :--- | ---: | :--- | :--- |
| Amazon item lifetime value | MAE **39.8580** | KurveRSC (September), 42.2731 | **5.7% lower MAE** |
| H&M user churn | ROC AUC **0.7085** | KurveRSC (latest), 0.7072 | Best of all 17 |
| Clinical-trial site success | MAE **0.2787** | GraphSAGE, 0.3249 | **14.2% lower MAE** |
:::

::: {.benchmark-caption}
Wins use the unrounded test scores, with no tied relflow
comparisons. [Per-task source data](https://github.com/PriorLabs/relarena/blob/fa4f1468c02b7dafd0c7b107544a887b83ca04c1/baseline_results/results.csv).
:::

## Featureless learning and real-time prediction

- **Featureless:** learn from typed fields and nested records without
  engineering a fixed-width table of aggregate features. The adapter
  derives a schema and bounded joins, then supplies raw values, timestamp
  ages, and nested histories, with **no DFS**. See
  [Featureless models](learn/featureless-models.qmd).
- **Real-time prediction:** deploy the trained model behind an
  [HTTP endpoint](guides/serving.qmd) to score incoming records as they
  arrive. The serving runtime loads the saved model and accepts individual
  JSON records, batches, or Arrow IPC streams.
- **Open source:** relflow is Apache-2.0 licensed, with the adapter, recipes,
  and evaluation results available in public repositories.
- **No ICL:** training produces task-specific model weights. Prediction
  uses those weights rather than a labeled demonstration set in the prompt
  or context. Text fields use a frozen MiniLM encoder.

The published adapter specifies the complete
[model and training recipe](https://github.com/PriorLabs/relarena/blob/fa4f1468c02b7dafd0c7b107544a887b83ca04c1/docs/models/relflow.md).
To use the same modeling approach on your own records, start with
[Your first model](learn/your-first-model.qmd) and
[Featureless models](learn/featureless-models.qmd).

## Calibrated with approximately US$1,500 in compute

The shared training recipes were calibrated using approximately
**US$1,500 in Modal research compute**, as reported in the
[original submission notes](https://github.com/PriorLabs/relarena/blob/f6d81c38947e3a9a69207321d3b0bc170f799392/docs/models/relflow.md).
That development budget produced shared size-tier presets covering the
21-task suite. Each task uses the frozen recipe selected by its training
size, with no per-task hyperparameter search in the submitted method.

This figure describes recipe-development compute. The published RelArena
scores come from the maintainers' subsequent reproduction of the frozen
submission.

## Protocol and reproducibility

This snapshot uses RelArena's **21 RelBench v1 entity tasks**, spanning
7 databases, 12 binary classification tasks and 9 regression tasks, all at
**seed 0**. Reported scores are held-out test results. The original inner
training-anchor count selects one fixed recipe per size tier; the final
model is refitted on training plus validation data. relflow's runs use an
**RTX Pro 6000**. Preparation, text encoding, final refit, and prediction
are included in the default-only benchmark runtime; the diagnostic inner
fit is recorded separately.

RelArena distinguishes **models**, which follow its standardized tuning
contract, from **systems**, which bring their own selection procedure.
relflow is a model submission. In the combined board it ranks **#4 of 17**,
ahead of RT-J and RT-PluRel; KurveRSC's latest system ranks second.
Each board fits Elo separately.
